notes: Every seed, LEGO, build, use and component phrase in seeds 1-167 was read in full; regex scans (time words after modals, 'I think'→我想, take/play/see) only surfaced candidates. Components were read but none is listed (never played; looser standard). 'other' rows are out-of-scope findings, all held. knockOn entries are ids, with '→' giving a proposed edit where useful. Holds tied to a LEGO re-cut (S0095L02 坐, S0098L03 弹, S0161L01 能周日, S0153L01, S0131L01, S0114L01, S0061L02, S0116L01) only make sense applied together with that LEGO.

decisions.why: LEGO 'take | 坐' teaches 坐 as English 'take' in general. 坐 means ride/sit — right for buses, trains, planes, never for taking an object. The seed's English ('go home on the next bus') does not even contain 'take' (L26), and the intro says "'take', as in 'I'd like to take this'", which teaches the wrong sense. K40: grow the LEGO to carry its vehicle: 'on the next bus | 坐下一班车' (exactly the seed's chunk), with 'bus' and 'the next bus' introduced before it (LEGO order = build-up order). Alternative if Kai prefers a smaller cut: 'take the bus | 坐班车'. Never delete the LEGO.
decisions.gloss: 坐 zuò = sit / ride (a vehicle)
knockOn: intro S0095L02 (as-in line 'I'd like to take this' must change)

decisions.why: 'take this' is taking an object (拿/带), but 坐这个 can only mean 'sit on / ride this'. The phrase teaches 坐 = take, the over-broad mapping learners reported. decisions.why: LEGO 'play | 弹' with no instrument. 弹 is only for plucked/struck instruments (piano, guitar); bare English 'play' is 玩 (games, play in general). No instrument (钢琴/吉他) is taught anywhere in the course, so every 'play' phrase here teaches play = 弹 — the error learners reported. Later the course teaches 'to play | 玩' (S0501L01) and 'like to play | 喜欢玩' (S0337L01), so 'play' now has two answers (ZUT). Recommended: seed 98 and this LEGO become 玩 (我应该考虑玩别的 = I should consider playing something else); S0501L01 then becomes not-new. Alternative: keep 弹 only if the seed gains an instrument (needs a new word). Never delete the LEGO.
decisions.gloss: 弹 tán = pluck/play (an instrument)
knockOn: S0337L01 / S0501L01 (outside range: would become not-new duplicates of play|玩)

decisions.why: Built on the broken LEGO 'completely way': 'the completely way / that complete way' is not English and 那个完全方式 is not Chinese. Nothing to salvage.
decisions.gloss: …完全方式… = …completely way…

after.known: why don't you go and ask?

decisions.why: Target 你为什么不去问 has 去 'go' and present tense; the English 'why didn't you ask?' lacks the LEGO 'go' and is past.
decisions.gloss: 你为什么不去问 = you why not go ask

before.known: that's completely what I was trying to say

after.known: that's exactly what I was trying to say

decisions.why: 'that's completely what I was trying to say' is not natural English.
decisions.gloss: 那完全是我想说的 = that completely is I want say (的)

decisions.why: Out of scope, listed. 我试试学习 for 'I'm trying to learn': 试试 is 'give it a go', so this reads 'I'll give studying a go'. 'trying to' is 试着 / 在努力. The S0002L01 LEGO 'to try | 试试' drives a whole pattern of '试试 + verb' rows. Pattern also at S0006 seed, S0034L01U03, S0133L01U07, S0135L01U04, S0146 seed + L02U03/U07/U08, S0148L02U06, S0149L01U03.
decisions.gloss: 我试试学习 wǒ shìshi xuéxí = I try-try study

before.known: I'm trying to remember a word

decisions.why: Out of scope, listed. 我试试想起一个词: 想起 is 'it comes back to me', so 'try to 想起' and 我想想起 (S0006L01B02) are awkward. Natural: 我在努力想一个词.
decisions.gloss: 我试试想起一个词 = I try recall one word

before.known: why are you learning her name?

after.known: why are you learning her name?
after.roman: nǐ wèishénme jì tā de míngzi?

decisions.why: Out of scope, listed. 学她的名字 'study her name' is odd Chinese; people 记 (remember) a name. Phrase rows under it are fixed above as A.
decisions.gloss: 你为什么学她的名字 = you why study her name

decisions.why: Chinese does not match: 我昨天多练习 is 'I practise more yesterday' (an instruction), not 'I practised a lot'; that needs 练习了很多 (了 not yet taught).
decisions.gloss: 我昨天多练习 = I yesterday more practise

before.known: it's a bit too much time

after.known: it's a bit too much time

decisions.why: Chinese word order: 有点太多时间 should be 时间有点太多.
decisions.gloss: 有点太多时间 = a-bit too-much time

before.known: if you make mistakes, it's okay

decisions.why: 还行 means 'so-so / passable', not 'it's okay' (= 没关系) or 'that's fine'. Same in S0050L01U03.
decisions.gloss: 如果你犯错，还行 = if you make-mistake, so-so

before.known: I want to do a few things

decisions.why: Measure word: things/matters take 件 (几件事, 这件事 — the course's own S0030 一件事 / seed 37 这件事), not 个. Same at S0056L01B03 几个事 and S0051L04B03 这个事.
decisions.gloss: 几个事 jǐ gè shì = few (general-measure) matters

decisions.why: 不足够 is stilted; 'not enough' is 不够. Same in S0058L02U03.
decisions.gloss: 不足够 bù zúgòu = not sufficient

before.known: I don't want to say that

after.known: I don't want to say that

decisions.why: 那 alone cannot be an object: 我不想说那 → 我不想说那个. Same in U12 我在解释那; U13 'I feel that | 我觉得那' is broken on both sides (delete).
decisions.gloss: 我不想说那 = I not want say that

decisions.why: LEGO 'more to learn | 更多要学': the seed says 还有很多要学 ('a lot to learn'); 更多要学 is neither in the seed (L26) nor natural.
decisions.gloss: 更多要学 gèng duō yào xué = more to learn

before.known: I'm very happy with how much I've learnt already
before.target: 我对自己已经学会的这么多很满意

after.known: I'm very happy with how much I've learnt already
after.target: 我对自己已经学了这么多很满意
after.roman: wǒ duì zìjǐ yǐjīng xué le zhème duō hěn mǎnyì

decisions.why: Seed Chinese 我对自己已经学会的这么多很满意 is ungrammatical (这么多 cannot follow 的 like that). Natural: 我对自己已经学了这么多很满意.
decisions.gloss: I towards self already learned (的) so-much very satisfied

before.known: can you tell me about those people?
before.target: 你能告诉我关于那些人吗？

decisions.why: 告诉我关于那些人 is ungrammatical (关于… needs a noun: 关于那些人的事). Same in S0111L01U03.
decisions.gloss: 你能告诉我关于那些人吗 = you can tell me about those people ?

decisions.why: ZUT: 'are you ready?' is 你准备好吗 here but 你准备好了吗 in S0080L02U03 and S0095L01U02. The 了 form is the natural one.
decisions.gloss: 你准备好吗 = you ready ?

decisions.why: LEGO 'speak more quickly | 说得更快' is not in its seed (seed: 想得够快 'think quickly enough'), L26.
decisions.gloss: 说得更快 = speak (得) more quick

decisions.why: 唯一这个 is ungrammatical (唯一 needs 的 + noun).
decisions.gloss: 唯一这个 = only this

decisions.why: LEGO 'bus | 班车': 班车 on its own is a shuttle/company bus; in the seed 下一班车 the 班 is the measure for scheduled runs. The course later teaches 'bus' = 公交车 (S0120), so 'take the bus' has two answers. Kai's call alongside the S0095L02 re-cut. Builds 'take bus' / 'ready to take bus' also lack 'the'.
decisions.gloss: 班车 bānchē = shuttle bus
knockOn: zho_for_eng:S0095L03B04 (→ ready to take the bus)

decisions.why: LEGO 'course | 门': 门 is a measure word (for languages/courses), never 'course' itself; its phrases use bare 这门 / 那门 with no noun, which is not Chinese (做这门, 练这门). Propose merging into 'this language | 这门语言'.
decisions.gloss: 门 mén = (measure for courses/languages)

before.known: we're not trying to hear many more words
before.target: 我们不是想再听很多更多的词

after.known: we're not trying to hear many more words
after.target: 我们不是想再听更多的词
after.roman: wǒmen bú shì xiǎng zài tīng gèng duō de cí

decisions.why: Seed 我们不是想再听很多更多的词 stacks 很多 and 更多 — ungrammatical. Natural: 我们不是想再听更多的词.
decisions.gloss: we not-is want again listen very-many more (的) words

before.known: we didn't hope to wake in the middle of the night

decisions.why: Seed 我们没希望半夜醒来: 没希望 means 'hopeless / no hope', not 'didn't hope to'. The English 'we didn't hope to wake…' is also stilted.
decisions.gloss: we no-hope midnight wake

before.known: I want to learn this new thing quickly

after.known: I want to learn this new thing quickly
after.roman: wǒ xiǎng jǐnkuài xué zhè xīn dōngxi

decisions.why: 快学 is not idiomatic and 'quickly' is taught as 尽快 (S0020L02) — ZUT.
decisions.gloss: 我想快学这新东西 = I want fast learn this new thing

decisions.why: LEGO 'unusual | 寻常': 寻常 means 'usual/ordinary'; 'unusual' is 不寻常 (every phrase already says 不寻常). The LEGO teaches the opposite meaning. Re-cut to 'unusual | 不寻常'.
decisions.gloss: 寻常 xúncháng = ordinary

decisions.why: LEGO 'so happy | 这么高兴' is not in its seed (seed: 很高兴 … 这么好), L26; and 我这么高兴 as a plain statement is unnatural.
decisions.gloss: 这么高兴 = this-much happy

before.known: that was a surprise, because he's my friend
before.target: 那很意外，但是他是我的朋友

decisions.why: Seed: English 'because' but Chinese 但是 'but' — the learner is taught 但是 = because, against S0022's 因为. Same in S0130L03U06.
decisions.gloss: 那很意外，但是他是我的朋友 = that very surprising, but he is my friend

before.known: she wants it to be perfect

after.known: she wants it to be perfect

decisions.why: 她想那完美 is ungrammatical ('she wants that perfect'); 她想让它完美 uses taught 让/它.
decisions.gloss: she want that perfect

decisions.why: LEGO 'very nervous | 非常紧张': 'very' is taught as 很 (S0013) and 非常 as 'extremely' (S0125); so 'I'm very nervous' has two answers.
decisions.gloss: 非常紧张 = extremely nervous

before.known: I'm not very good at this

decisions.why: 我这个不太好 is not Chinese for 'I'm not very good at this'.
decisions.gloss: I this not-very good

decisions.why: 'where did she go?' needs 了 (她去哪里了？), as U15 has.
decisions.gloss: 她去哪里 = she go where

decisions.why: LEGO 'be able to | 办法': 办法 is 'way/means' (already taught as 'way | 办法', S0094L01); 没办法 is 'no way to'. The gloss teaches 办法 = be able to, and 'won't be able to' now has two answers (不能 / 没办法). Propose 'no way to | 没办法' (in the seed).
decisions.gloss: 办法 bànfǎ = method, way

before.known: I don't know what I'm trying to say

decisions.why: 我不知道我想说的 is ungrammatical for 'I don't know what I'm trying to say' (needs 我想说什么). Same in U07.
decisions.gloss: I not know I want say (的)

before.known: what do you think about that

after.known: what do you think about that

decisions.why: 你觉得怎么样那个 puts the object after 怎么样 — ungrammatical; 你觉得那个怎么样 (LEGO words around it, K49).
decisions.gloss: you think how that

before.known: my name is not very unusual
before.target: 我的名字并不太不寻常

decisions.why: Seed 我的名字并不太不寻常 stacks negatives (并不 + 太 + 不寻常) — not natural Chinese; 'not very unusual' is 并不怎么特别 / 不算太特别. Whole LEGO S0166L01 follows it.
decisions.gloss: my name actually not too un-usual
